name: OneMain Holdings (OMF)
teaser: Hold, watchlist for new money. At $57.23 the shares trade 10.3% above my Base value of $51.90, and the maximum buy price is $36.33. The required margin of safety is 30% because Confidence is B (18.8/25). The Bear value is $31.78, 44.5% below the price, because a nonprime lender with 5.5 times leverage can lose more than half of its earnings when credit turns. For a holder, the 7.3% dividend and the buybacks justify keeping the shares. For new money, the price already assumes charge-offs keep falling and returns on equity stay near 20%.
llms: OneMain is a nonprime US consumer lender (personal loans, auto, cards) funded by debt, valued on ten years of distributable earnings at a 12% cost of equity with an exit-multiple cross-check. 7.3% dividend yield, price implies a roughly 20% return on equity with no fade.
